summary: Frontend-only regression on compact track rows across 4 screens (collection, search, playlist detail, favorites). All screens render without crash on mobile viewport (390x844). The syntax-error regression in collection/[id].tsx did NOT reproduce - screen loads and functions correctly. Density target met: 12 visible track rows in August Releases after passing the hero header (previously ~7), and 10 visible rows in Search results. Play-on-tap, blue playing border, MiniPlayer, and the + AddToPlaylist modal all work. End-to-end library flow (create playlist -> add track from collection via + -> open playlist detail with compact rows) verified. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av still in use (SDK 54 removal); not caused by this iteration but flagged.

issues: Collection header (200x200 cover + name + 'N tracks') occupies ~600px vertical space; only 6 rows visible on top of scroll and 12 visible once the header is scrolled off. Consider a smaller collapsible header to further increase density on first-paint.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av is deprecated in SDK 54 and will be removed. Migrate to expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video). Reference: frontend/app/contexts/AudioPlayerContext.tsx (console warning: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54.')
Uses deprecated prop 'pointerEvents' on <View>; move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/collection/[id].tsx:94
Image style.resizeMode is deprecated; use props.resizeMode. Warning fired by several image components across the app.

Non-route files under /app/frontend/app/{components,constants,context,contexts,utils} trigger 'Route is missing the required default export' warnings (AddToPlaylistModal.tsx, MiniPlayer.tsx, musicData.ts, AudioPlayerContext.tsx, playlistStorage.ts, etc.). Move these out of the app/ directory or prefix with _ so Expo Router does not treat them as routes.

action_items: None blocking for this iteration - compact-row feature works and no regression from the fixed syntax error was found.
Follow-up (unrelated to this iteration): migrate expo-av -> expo-audio/expo-video before SDK 55.
Follow-up: replace deprecated props (pointerEvents on View, style.resizeMode on Image, textShadow*, shadow*) to silence warnings.
Follow-up: relocate non-screen files (components/, contexts/, utils/, constants/) out of app/ directory to avoid Expo Router 'missing default export' warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: collection/[id].tsx StyleSheet is intact after the reported syntax-error fix; renderTrackItem, trackCard, trackPressable, trackCover(40x40), trackTitle(fontSize 14) and paddingVertical:6 all present and valid.
search.tsx trackCard uses paddingVertical:6, cover 36x36, title fontSize 14 - matches PRD.
playlist/[id].tsx trackCard uses paddingVertical:6, cover 32x32, title fontSize 14 - matches PRD.
favorites.tsx trackCard uses paddingVertical:6 and cover 32x32 - matches PRD.
constants/musicData.ts is 4013 lines - consider splitting per-folder track lists into separate module files for maintainability (>700 line rule).
seed_data_creation: Created a local playlist 'Test Compact PL' in AsyncStorage during testing and added 'Luda Went Down To Georgia' to it. This is client-only (AsyncStorage) and only persists within the browser session used for the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a client-only Expo SDK 54 web preview with hardcoded music data (no backend). Public URL: https://rehab-beats-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. There are NO testIDs on tracks - use text selectors or coordinate clicks. The AddToPlaylist modal is a Portal so its text is not captured in document.body.innerText slice(0,800) - verify via full innerText or screenshot. To count 'visible' rows use `img[src*='track-icon']` intersecting viewport. Header takes ~600px on collection screen; scroll ~600px before density measurement.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this was a regression check after E1 fixed a self-introduced syntax error in collection/[id].tsx during row compaction. Verified: the file parses, screen loads, all styles render, no red-screen, no runtime errors on any of the 4 modified screens.
